title: Jerusalem-Spiced Polish Perilla-Seed-Deulkkae Pierogi
description: A unique, springy Polish dish featuring the distinct flavors of perilla seeds and deulkkae, finished with a smoky Jerusalem spice blend.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and warm water, and knead for 5 minutes to form a dough.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces, and roll each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of roasted deulkkae mixture onto the center of each dough circle, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the dough over the filling, and press the edges together to seal the pierogi.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat, and add a tablespoon of vegetable oil.
When the oil is hot, add a few pierogi to the skillet, and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Remove the cooked pierogi from the skillet, and transfer them to a serving plate.
Repeat the cooking process with the remaining pierogi, and serve hot with a sprinkle of Jerusalem spice blend.
Garnish with chopped onion and a dollop of sour cream, if desired.
